# Description

This form provides for the reporting of operational and catch data from purse seine fisheries under the IOTC Regional Observer Scheme (ROS). The form is designed to capture verified information on fishing activity, catch composition, and bycatch associated with purse seine operations, including IOTC species, and other bycatch species. The reporting format follows the standards adopted by the IOTC Scientific Committee and includes multiple hierarchical data levels, ranging from trip and set information to species-specific catch and bycatch records. Data collected through this form contribute to scientific assessments of tuna and tuna-like species and support monitoring of the impact of purse seine fisheries on associated and dependent species. CPCs are required to complete the form for purse seine operations covered by the ROS, ensuring consistency, transparency, and quality of the data collected by scientific observers at sea or Electronic Monitoring Systems.

Click [here](./Form-ROS-PS.xlsx) to download a blank version of Form ROS-PS, or [return](./index.html) to the list of all IOTC statistical data reporting forms.

# Data content

Form ROS-PS is an XLSX workbook comprising 13 sheets, designed to report the mandatory (<span style="color: blue;">M; blue cells</span>) and optional (<span style="color: green;">O; green cells</span>) data fields defined by the SC. The current version builds on the most recent revision of ROS fields endorsed at the 27^th^ session of the SC ([IOTC-2024-SC27-DATA01](https://iotc.org/documents/SC/27/DATA01)). The sheets are interconnected through technical identifiers (e.g., observer trip ID, set ID), enabling the hierarchical organisation of the observations to be maintained.

| Sheet | Data Components | Resolution |  Description |
| :---------- | :----------: | :--------: | :----------------------------- |
| [META](#meta) | Metadata | Trip | Information on the data submission by reporting fleet |
| [O-INFO](#oInfo) | Metadata |  Trip | Observer identification and information of the observed fishing trip |
| [V-INFO](#vInfo) | Metadata | Trip | Identification of the fishing vessel and personnel information |
| [V-TRIP](#vTrip) | Metadata | Trip | Information on the fishing trip's course |
| [V-ATTRIBUTES](#vAttributes) | Technology / Equipment | Vessel | Information on the vessel's attributes and equipment |
| [G-GENERAL](#gGeneral) | Gear configuration | Trip | Information on the fishing gear's equipment and machinery | 
| [E-SET](#eSet) | Gear Technology / Equipment | Operations | Information on setting by operations |
| [E-SET-CETACEANS](#eSetCetaceans) | Effort | Operations | Information on cetacean sightings and interactions |
| [E-SET-CATCHES](#eSetCatches) | Catch | Operations | Information on magnitude, composition, and fate of catch |
| [E-SET-CATCH-SPECIMENS](#eSetCatchSpecimens) | Catch | Species | Information on fish biology (size, sex, maturity), samples, and depredation |
| [E-SET-CATCH-SPECIMENS-SSI](#eSetCatchSpecimensSSI) | Catch | Species | Information on Species of Special Interest (SSI) caught in the observed trip |
| [E-SET-TAG-DETAILS](#eSetTagDetails) | Catch | Species | Information on specimen condition and tag details |
| [DAILY-ACTIVITIES](#dailyActivities) | Metadata | Trip | Information on the locations of various trip activities |

# Metadata {#meta}

## Submission Information

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| Liaison officer full name | M | Name of the liaison officer in charge of the compilation of the data  | String | e.g., `John Doe`  |
| Liaison officer email | M | Email address of the liaison officer in charge of the compilation of the data | Valid email address | e.g., `John.Doe@fao.org` |
| Organisation name | M | Name of the organisation in charge of the compilation of the data | String | e.g., `Institute of Fisheries` |
| Organisation email | O | Email address of the organisation in charge of the compilation of the data | Valid email address | e.g., `nif@gov.sc` |
| Finalisation date | M | Date of finalisation of the dataset | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) | e.g., `1996-03-27` |
| [Submission date]{#subdate} | M | Date of submission of the dataset | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) | e.g., `1997-03-21` |

## General Information

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| Reporting year | M | Gregorian calendar year of the fishing activities reported through the dataset | 4-digit integer | e.g., `1996` |
| Reporting entity | M | Three-letter (alpha-3) code of the entity reporting the dataset to the IOTC Secretariat | **Code** from [Entities](#entities) | e.g., `EUR` |
| Flag / Chartering state | M | The country registration of the fishing vessels or chartering flag in case of chartering agreement | **Code** from [Countries](#countries) | e.g., `FRA` |
| Data source | M | The source of data provided: 'OAS' for data collected by Observers at sea and 'EMS' for data derived from Electronic Monitoring Systems | **Code** from [Source of data](#dataSource) | e.g., `OB` |

# O-INFO {#oInfo}

This section of the form includes information about the observer and an overview of the fishing trip they observed.

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| observed_trip_id | M | Unique identifier of the fishing trip defined as the concatenation of (i) the observation or trip start date (YYYY-MM-DD), (ii) the IOTC observer number, (iii) the IOTC vessel identifier as per Record of Authorised Vessels ([RAV](https://rav.iotc.org/)) and the vessel [gear group](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/fisheries/#gearGroups) code as per IOTC classification | Alphanumeric | e.g., `2024-01-23/IOTC001/IOTC012345/PS` |

## Observer Identification

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| iotc_id | M | The unique registration identifier assigned to each observer by the IOTC Secretariat | Alphanumeric | e.g., `IOTC_0976` |
| full_name | O | The name of the scientific observer(s) that collected the data on-board the fishing vessel or EM reviewer | String | e.g., `John Doe` |

## Observer Trip Details

| **Embarkation:** The starting port. If the first observation is available after the departure from the port while the vessel is within port limits, this is still recorded as the observation starting port. If the observation starts at sea outside port limits (onboard observer boarding the vessel via a vessel transfer or EM records not available at the trip starting date due to a recording failure), record "at sea".
::: {style="margin-left:40px"}

| **In port**
:::
::: {style="margin-left:80px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| country | O | The country or EEZ of the observation starting location | **Code** from [Countries](#countries) | e.g., `FRA` |
| port | O | The port of the observation starting location | **Code** from [Ports](#ports) | e.g., `REREU` |
:::

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| **At sea**
:::
::: {style="margin-left:80px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| latitude | M | The latitude of the observation starting location, expressed in decimal degrees according to the WGS 84 reference system (EPSG:4326). Recommended precision: four decimal places (~10 m) | adapted from [ISO 6709](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_6709) [+/-DD.DDDD] | e.g., `-20.8854` |
| longitude | M | The longitude of the observation starting location, expressed in decimal degrees according to the WGS 84 reference system (EPSG:4326). Recommended precision: four decimal places (~10 m) | adapted from [ISO 6709](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_6709) [+/-DDD.DDDD] | e.g., `55.5312` |
:::
::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
||||||
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| date_time_utc | M | The date and time of the start of observations in Coordinated Universal Time ([UTC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coordinated_Universal_Time)) | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) [YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ] | e.g., `2025-09-15T12:00Z` |
:::

| **Disembarkation:** The ending port. If the last observation is available after a port launch while the vessel is within port limits, this is still considered as the observation ending port. If the observation ends at sea outside port limits (onboard observer disembarking boarding the vessel via a vessel transfer or EM records not available at the end of observations due to a recording failure) , it is considered "at sea".

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| **In port**
:::
::: {style="margin-left:80px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| country | O | The country or EEZ of the observation ending location | **Code** from [Countries](#countries) | e.g., `FRA` |
| port | O | The port of the observation ending location | **Code** from [Ports](#ports) | e.g., `REREU` |
:::
::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| **At sea**
:::

::: {style="margin-left:80px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| latitude | M | The latitude of the observation ending location, expressed in decimal degrees according to the WGS 84 reference system (EPSG:4326). Recommended precision: four decimal places (~10 m) | adapted from [ISO 6709](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_6709) [+/-DD.DDDD] | e.g., `-20.8854` |
| longitude | M | The longitude of the observation ending location, expressed in decimal degrees according to the WGS 84 reference system (EPSG:4326). Recommended precision: four decimal places (~10 m) | adapted from [ISO 6709](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_6709) [+/-DDD.DDDD] | e.g., `55.5312` |
:::

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
||||||
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| date_time_utc | M | The date and time corresponding to the end of observations in Coordinated Universal Time ([UTC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coordinated_Universal_Time)) | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) [YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ] | e.g., `2025-09-15T12:00Z` |
:::

## Observed Trip Summary

| **Number of fishing sets:**: The total number of purse seine sets deployed by the vessel or observed by the scientific observer during a single fishing trip. Each set corresponds to one complete deployment of the purse seine.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| conducted | M | The total number of fishing sets conducted by the vessel from the observation starting date to the observation ending date, regardless their catch and data collection activities | Integer | e.g., `45` |
| observed | M | The total number of fishing sets monitored by the observer. In the case of EM, only processed sets to be included | Integer | e.g., `45` |
:::

| **Number of hours:** The total number of hours the vessel is on a fishing trip, with each day defined as a 24-hour period. These days can be further categorised by activity type (e.g. searching, transiting, actively fishing, or present in fishing areas). 

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| searching | M | The number of hours searching during the observation period | Integer | e.g., `420` |
| actively_fishing | M | The number of active fishing hours during the observation period | Integer | e.g., `75` |
| in_fishing_area | O | The number of hours in the fishing area during the observation period | Integer | e.g., `480` |
| transiting | O | The number of hours transiting during the observation period | Integer | e.g., `100` |
| lost | M | The number of hours lost during the observation period | Integer | e.g., `5` | 
:::

| **Reasons for lost days:** The reason(s) a vessel was unable to fish: (i) adverse weather conditions, (ii) mechanical breakdown or inoperative gear or (iii) unforeseen events (specify).  

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| reason | O | The main reasons for days at sea lost to fishing activity. Up to 4 reasons may be reported on the form | **Code** from [Reasons for Days Lost](#reasonsDaysLost) | e.g., `AW` |
:::

# V-INFO {#vInfo}

This section of the form includes specific vessel information.

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| observed_trip_id | M | The parent observed trip identifier | Alphanumeric | e.g., `2024-01-23/IOTC001/IOTC012345/PS` |

## Vessel Information

| **Identification**: Unique identifiers and key details of the vessel to uniquely identify the vessel in fisheries and observer records.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| name | M | The vessel full name as recorded on vessel official documentation or record the vessel full name as imprinted on the vessel itself or Electronic Monitoring records | String | e.g., `HAWWA` |
| flag_or_chartering_state | M | The country code of registration or chartering | **Code** from [Countries](#countries) | e.g., `OMN` |
| iotc_ID | M | The unique identification number assigned to the vessel by the IOTC when it is included in the Record of Authorised Vessels | Alphanumeric | e.g., `IOTC003810` |
| imo_number | O | The unique vessel identification number assigned by the International Maritime Organization | Seven-digit number | e.g., `9359698` |
| ircs | O | The unique alphanumeric code (International Radio Call Sign; IRCS) assigned to the vessel for radio communications, as recorded in official registration documents radio call sign (when available) | Alphanumeric | e.g., `A4DP6` |
:::

| **Registration**: Official vessel registration details to uniquely identify the vessel within the national or regional registry.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| country | O | The code of vessel's country of registry | **Code** from [Countries](#countries) | e.g., `FRA` |
| port | O | The code of vessel's port of registry (also called home port) shown on its registration documents and lettered on the stern of the ship's hull – also include the country | **Code** from [Ports](#ports) | e.g., `REREU` |
| registration_number | O | The number issued by country in which the vessel is registered, shown on its registration documents and written on the hull of the vessel. This may be a combination of characters and numbers; record them all | Alphanumeric or numeric according to CPC standards | e.g., `CBG303`|
:::

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| licensed_target_species | O | The licensed target species as specified in vessel licences or permit conditions. Vessels will generally target a narrow range or aggregation of species, however one or more might not be an IOTC species; record them all | **Code** from [All Species](#allSpecies) | e.g., `AL` |
| main_fishing_gear | M |The main vessel fishing gear | **Code** from [Fishing Gear](#fishingGear) | e.g., `DL` |

| **Vessel Personnel:** Details of the individuals working onboard during the fishing trip as well as the total number of crew members onboard.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| fishing_master_name | M | The full name of the fishing master recorded as first and last names | String | e.g., `John Doe` |
| fishing_master_nationality | M | The nationality of the fishing master | **Code** from [Countries](#countries) | e.g., `FRA` |
| skipper_captain_name | M | Name of the skipper or captain recorded as first and last names| String | e.g., `John Doe` |
| skipper_captain_nationality | M | Nationality of the skipper or captain | **Code** from [Countries](#countries) | e.g., `FRA` |
| crew_number | O | The number of crew onboard the vessel during the trip | Integer | e.g., `26` |
:::

# V-TRIP {#vTrip}

This section of the form includes information about the overall fishing trip of the vessel.

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| observed_trip_id | M | The parent observed trip identifier | Alphanumeric | e.g., `2024-01-23/IOTC001/IOTC012345/PS` |

## Trip Details

| **Vessel departure:** The name and/or geographical coordinates of the port from where the vessel sailed – also include the country. If the vessel started a new trip at sea following transhipment record 'at-sea’ plus the geographical coordinates corresponding to the location the trip started
::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| **In port**
:::

::: {style="margin-left:80px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| country | O | The country or EEZ from which the trip started | **Code** from [Countries](#countries) | e.g., `FRA` |
| port | O | The port from which the trip started | **Code** from [Ports](#ports) | e.g., `REREU` |
| latitude | M | The latitude from which the trip started, expressed in decimal degrees according to the WGS 84 reference system (EPSG:4326). Recommended precision: four decimal places (~10 m) | adapted from [ISO 6709](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_6709) [+/-DD.DDDD] | e.g., `-20.8854` |
| longitude | M | The longitude from which the trip started, expressed in decimal degrees according to the WGS 84 reference system (EPSG:4326). Recommended precision: four decimal places (~10 m) | adapted from [ISO 6709](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_6709) [+/-DDD.DDDD] | e.g., `55.5312` |
:::

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| date_time_utc | M | The date and time the vessel departed from port in Coordinated Universal Time ([UTC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coordinated_Universal_Time)) | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) [YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ] | e.g., `2025-09-15T12:00Z` |
:::

| **Vessel return:** The name and/or geographical coordinates of the port where the vessel returned – also include the country. If the vessel arrived at a transhipment location record 'at-sea' plus the geographical coordinates corresponding to the location the transhipment started. If the observer disembarked before the vessel returned then record expected port of return as provided by the vessel

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| **In port**
:::

::: {style="margin-left:80px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| country | O |The country or EEZ from which the trip ended | **Code** from [Countries](#countries) | e.g., `FRA` |
| port | O | The port from which the trip ended | **Code** from [Ports](#ports) | e.g., `REREU` |
| latitude | M | The latitude from which the trip ended, expressed in decimal degrees according to the WGS 84 reference system (EPSG:4326). Recommended precision: four decimal places (~10 m) | adapted from [ISO 6709](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_6709) [+/-DD.DDDD] | e.g., `-20.8854` |
| longitude | M | The longitude from which the trip ended, expressed in decimal degrees according to the WGS 84 reference system (EPSG:4326). Recommended precision: four decimal places (~10 m) | adapted from [ISO 6709](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_6709) [+/-DDD.DDDD] | e.g., `55.5312` |
:::

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
||||||
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| date_time_utc | M | The date and time (in Coordinated Universal Time, UTC) corresponding to the end of the vessel trip at the reported location | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) [YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ] | e.g., `2025-09-15T12:00Z` |
:::

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| gross_tonnage | O | Gross tonnage (GT), a dimensionless measure of vessel's internal volume from registration documents | Integer | e.g., `2319` |
| loa_m | O | The vessel overall length (m) as specified in vessel registration documents | Floats | e.g., `84.1` |
| hull_material | O | The primary material used in the construction of the vessel's hull | **Code** from [Hull Material Types](#hullMaterialTypes) | e.g., `AL` |

| **Main engines:** The make (brand) and power of the two main engines.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| make | O | The manufacturer or brand name of the vessel's engine, as specified in the official vessel registration or engine documentation | String | e.g., `MAN Energy Solutions`  |
| power_value | O | The rated power output of the vessel's main engine as specified in the official vessel registration or engine documentation | Integer | e.g., `5000` |
| power_unit | O | Rated output of the vessel's main engine, as specified in official registration or engine documentation in kilowatts (kW), horsepower (hp), or break horsepower (bhp) | String | e.g., `kW` |
:::

||||||
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| fish_storage_capacity_m3 | O | Total volume of fish hold(s) (cubic metres; m^3^) | Float | e.g., `1100` |

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Element | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| preservation_method | O | The fish preservation methods used by the vessel to preserve the catch during the trip. Up to four preservation methods may be reported on the form | **Code** from [Fish Preservation Methods](#fishPreservationMethods) | e.g., `BR` |
::: 

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Element | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| storage_type | O | The type of structure(s) onboard used by the vessel to store its catch. Up to three storage types may be reported on the form. |  **Code** from [Fish Storage Types](#fishStorageTypes) | e.g., `BF` |
:::

| **Autonomy range:** Vessel autonomy, expressed as the number of days a vessel can remain at sea without refuelling. If this information is not available, autonomy may be expressed as cruising distance (nm).

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| range_value | O | The vessel's operational endurance, expressed either as the maximum number of days it can remain at sea without resupply, or as the maximum distance it can cover (in nautical miles, nm) | Float | e.g., `30` |
| range_unit  | O | The unit used to describe the value of autonomy range | days or nm | e.g., `days` |
:::

# G-GENERAL {#gGeneral}

This section of the reporting form describes the purse seine fishing gear present on the vessel.

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| observed_trip_id  | M | The parent observed trip identifier | Alphanumeric | e.g., `2024-01-23/IOTC001/IOTC012345/PS` |

## Special Equipment or Machinery

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| power_block | O | Indicates whether or not the vessel is equipped with this technology | **Code** from [Logical Responses](#logicalResponses) | e.g., `TRUE` |
| purse_winch | O | Indicates whether or not the vessel is equipped with this technology | **Code** from [Logical Responses](#logicalResponses) | e.g., `TRUE` |

## General Gear Attributes

| **Purse seine net:** Net characterized by the use of a purse line at the bottom of the net. The purse line enables the net to be closed like a purse and thus retain all the fish caught.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| **Maximum length:** The total length of the purse seine net measured along the topline (corkline), from one end to the other, when fully extended. This represents the maximum horizontal extent of the net that can be deployed during a set.
:::

::: {style="margin-left:80px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| value | O | The maximum length of the net according to the net specifications | Float | e.g., `2.5` |
| unit | O | The unit of the net maximum length (m or km) | String | e.g., `km` |
:::
::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| **Maximum depth:** The maximum vertical depth of the purse seine net, measured from the corkline (topline) to the leadline (bottom line) when the net is fully extended. This indicates the maximum fishing depth that the gear can reach under ideal conditions 
:::
::: {style="margin-left:80px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| value | O | The maximum fishing depth according to the net specifications | Float | e.g., `150` |
| unit | O | The unit of the net maximum depth (m or km) | String | e.g., `m` |
:::
| **Mesh size:** The stretched mesh size of the purse seine net, measured knot-to-knot when the mesh is pulled taut. This measurement represents the distance between opposing knots and indicates the size of the openings in the netting. Mesh size may vary between sections of the net (e.g., wings, mid-net, bunt) according to their function.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| **Bunt Stretched:** The stretched mesh size of the bunt section of the purse seine net, measured knot-to-knot when the mesh is pulled taut. This indicates the size of the openings in the bunt where fish are concentrated during hauling.
:::
::: {style="margin-left:80px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| value | O | The numerical measurement of the bunt stretched mesh size | Float | e.g., `55` |
| unit | O | The unit of the stretched mesh size of the bunt section (mm, cm or m) | String | e.g., `mm`  |
:::
::: {style="margin-left:40px"}

| **Mid-net Stretched:** The stretched mesh size of the mid-net, i.e., the main body of the purse seine between the wings and the bunt, measured knot-to-knot when the mesh is pulled taut. This indicates the size of the openings in the mid-net that funnel the school toward the bunt.
:::

::: {style="margin-left:80px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| value | O | The average stretched mesh length of the mid-net (measured knot-to-knot). Usually calculated by measuring three consecutive meshes and taking the average | Float | e.g., `70` |
| unit | O | The unit of measurement for the stretched mesh size of the mid-net section (mm, cm, or m) | String | e.g., `mm`  |
:::

**Maximum Brail Capacity**: the maximum brailing capacity for the purse seine net, where the brail is defined as the basket-shaped net used to lift the fish from the bunt of the purse seine into the vessel.

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| value_t | O | The maximum weight capacity of a full brail in metric tonnes (t) | Float | e.g., `7` |

# E-SET {#eSet}

This section describes details of each of the setting operations within the fishing trip.

## Setting Operations

| Field | Requirement | Description | Reporting format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| observed_trip_id  | M | The parent observed trip identifier | Alphanumeric | e.g., `2024-01-23/IOTC001/IOTC012345/PS` |
| set_id | M | The unique four-digit numerical code for each fishing set, beginning with 0001 and assigned consecutively from the first to the last line set of the observed trip | 4-digit number | e.g., `0007` |

| **Start setting:** Details on the start of setting operations.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| date_time_utc | M | The date and the time the first dhan buoy and / or radio buoy is deployed to start the setting of the line in Coordinated Universal Time ([UTC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coordinated_Universal_Time)) | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) [YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ] | e.g., `2025-09-15T12:00Z` |
| latitude | M | The latitude of the position at the start of the setting operation, expressed in decimal degrees according to the WGS 84 reference system (EPSG:4326). Recommended precision: four decimal places (~10 m) | adapted from [ISO 6709](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_6709) [+/-DD.DDDD] | e.g., `-20.8854` |
| longitude | M | The longitude of the position at the start of the setting operation, expressed in decimal degrees according to the WGS 84 reference system (EPSG:4326). Recommended precision: four decimal places (~10 m) | adatped from [ISO 6709](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_6709) [+/-DDD.DDDD] | e.g., `55.5312` |
:::

| **School Sighting Cues:** The visual or instrumental signs used to detect the presence of a tuna school before setting the net. These cues may include natural indicators such as bird activity, fish jumping or surface ripples, floating objects, discoloured water, or instrumental detections from sonar, echo sounders, or radars.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| cue | O | School sighting cues which lead the vessel to detect the presence of the tuna school. Up to four cues may be reported on the form | **Code** from [Sighting Cues](#sightingCues) | e.g., `AF` |
:::

||||||
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| school_types | M | The type of tuna school encountered | **Code** from [School Types](#schoolTypes) | e.g., `FS`  |
| first_detection_method | O | The method by which the vessel first detected the tuna school, floating object, or bird aggregation. If multiple cues were observed, this field records the one that first prompted the vessel to change course | **Code** from [Detection Methods](#schoolDetectionMethods) | e.g., `AS` |
| school_size_t | O | The estimation of the size of the tuna school being targeted (in tonnes) | Float | e.g., `60`  |
| date_time_net_pursed_utc | O | The date and time when the net is fully pursed, i.e., all rings are up, in Coordinated Universal Time ([UTC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coordinated_Universal_Time)) | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) [YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ] | e.g., `2025-09-15T12:00Z` |

| **Brailing:** The operation of lifting fish from the bunt of a purse seine net into the vessel using a brail, a basket-shaped net. This concentrates the catch and transfers it on board for sorting and storage. 

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| date_time_start_utc | O | The date and time the brailing operation starts in Coordinated Universal Time ([UTC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coordinated_Universal_Time)) | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) [YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ] | e.g., `2025-09-15T12:00Z` |
| date_time_end_utc | O | The date and time the brailing operation ends | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) [YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ] | e.g., `2025-09-15T12:00Z` |
:::

||||||
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| date_time_skiff_onboard_utc | M | The date and time the skiff comes on board and the set is over in Coordinated Universal Time ([UTC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coordinated_Universal_Time)) | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) [YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MMZ] | e.g., `2025-09-15T12:00Z` |
| maximum_closing_net_depth_m | O | The real, measured, closed net depth in metres (m) | Float | e.g., `60` |

| **Object details** 

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| buoy_id | O | The unique identifier of the buoy | Alphanumeric | e.g., `ISD+295781` |
 
::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
**FAD equipped with artificial lights** Characterises artificial lights on the DFAD.
:::

::: {style="margin-left:80px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| at_deploy | O | Indicates whether or not artificial lights were present at this time | **Code** from [Logical Responses](#logicalResponses) | e.g., `FALSE` |
| on_retrieval | O | Indicates whether or not artificial lights were present at this time | **Code** from [Logical Responses](#logicalResponses) | e.g., `FALSE` |
:::

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| **FAD design:** Characterizes FAD design using fields of current version of reporting forms on activities with FOBs and instrumented buoys.
:::

::: {style="margin-left:80px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| raft_design | O | The description of the materials and construction of the floating raft of a drifting FAD, e.g., ecological coverings or netting of specified mesh size) | **Code** from [FAD Raft Designs](#fadRaftDesigns) | e.g., `EM`  |
| tail_design | O | The description of the construction and mesh size of the submerged appendage of a drifting FAD, e.g., net panels with specified stretched mesh size | **Code** from [FAD Tail Designs](#fadTailsDesigns) | e.g., `NL` |
:::

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| observed_trip_id | M | The parent observed trip identifier | Alphanumeric | e.g., `2024-01-23/IOTC001/IOTC012345/PS` |

## Catch Details

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| species | M | The species code for the portion of catch observed | **Code** from [All Species](#allSpecies) | e.g., `ABL` | 

| **Fate:** The fate which includes whether it was retained or discarded and the reason.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:-------|:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| fate_type | M | The outcome of the catch, indicating whether a fish was retained on board or discarded | **Code** from [Types of Fate](#fateTypes) | e.g., `DI` |
| fate | M | The final disposition of the catch or sampled portion of the catch, indicating whether it was retained on board or discarded, with specification of the reason where applicable | **Code** from [Fates](#fates) | e.g., `DL` |
:::

||||||
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| sampling_method | M | The method applied to derive the total catch from the samples collected during observation | **Code** from [Sampling Methods for Catch Estimation](#samplingMethodsCatchEstimation) | e.g., `EP` |
| number_of_fish | M | The numbers of individuals observed/caught by species and fate (including if recording at an individual animal level) | Integer | `183` |

| **Weight:** The catch weight corresponding to the specified species and product type recorded in processing type. If the fish has not been processed, it corresponds to the unprocessed weight.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| processing_type | M | Form in which the fish is processed prior to storage | **Code** from [Fish Processing Types](#fishProcessingTypes) | e.g., `DR` |
| value_kg | M | The value of fish weight expressed in kilograms (kg) | Float | e.g., `35` |
| estimation_method | M | The method applied to derive the weight from the samples collected during observation | **Code** from [Total Catch Estimation](#totalCatchEstimation) | e.g., `EP` |
:::

# E-SET-CATCH-SPECIMENS {#eSetCatchSpecimens}

This section of the form is for the recording of biological information of the specimens sampled during individual sets.

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| observed_trip_id | M | The parent observed trip identifier | Alphanumeric | e.g., `2024-01-23/IOTC001/IOTC012345/PS` |
| set_id  | M | The parent set identifier | 4-digit number | e.g., `0007` | |
| catch_id | M | The parent catch identifier | Alphanumeric  | e.g., `tbd`|
| specimen_id | M | A unique four-digit numerical code for each specimen, beginning with 0001, assigned consecutively within the same catch detail of a set during the observed trip | Alphanumeric | e.g., `tbd`  |

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| sampling_method | M | The sampling method used for the collection of biometric information on specimens | **Code** from [Biological Sampling Method](#biologicalSamplingMethod) | e.g., `ES` |

| **Length:** The specimen's individual length corresponding to the specified length type. Up to two length measurements may be reported on the form.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| length_type | M | The type of length used for the measurement | **Code** from [Length Measurements](#lengthMeasurements) | e.g., `CF` |
| length_value_cm | M | The value of length corresponding to the length type taken rounded to the lower centimetre | Float | e.g., `34` |
| length_measuring_tool | M | The tool used for the measurement of the fish length | **Code** from [Length Measurement Tools](#lengthMeasurementTools) | e.g., `CA`  |
<!-- | is_straight | M | Indicates whether the size measurement was made straight (Yes/No/Unk) | String | e.g., `Yes` | -->
:::

| **Weight:** The specimen's weight corresponding to the specified product type recorded in 'weight code'. The specimen's individual weight corresponding to the specified specie and product type. Unprocessed weight when the fish has not been processed.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| weight_processing_type | O | The processing/dressing used for the weight measurement | **Code** from [Weight Measurements](#weightMeasurements)  | e.g., `GG` |
| weight_value_kg | O | The weight corresponding to the weight measurement type code | Float | e.g., `43.2` |
| weight_estimation_method | O | The method used to estimate the weight of the specimen | **Code** from [Weight Measurement Tools](#weightMeasurementTools) | e.g., `BR` |
:::

| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| Sex | O | The sex of the sampled fish specimen | **Code** from [Sex](#sex) | e.g., `F` |

| **Maturity:** The stage of maturity of the specimen according to standard maturity scales approved by the IOTC.

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| maturity_scale | O | The standardised system used to classify the reproductive development of fish (i.e., source) | String | e.g., `ICCAT` |
| maturity_stage | O | The reproductive stage of a fish determined through visual inspection of the gonads without the aid of a microscope | **Code** from [Maturity Stages](#maturityStages) | e.g., `DEV` | 
:::

| **Sample collected:** Details on the collection of samples: a) type (e.g., otoliths, spine clippings, and genetic samples), b) preservation method (e.g., alcohol, frozen, etc.), c) destination (i.e., location to be sent/stored).

::: {style="margin-left:40px"}
| Field | Requirement | Description | Format | Input value |
|:------- |:-----:|:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| sample_type | O | The type of sample collected by the observer | **Code** from [Sampling Type](#samplingMethodsForSamplingCollections) | e.g., `WM`|
| sample_preservation_method | O | The type of preservation method used to preserve the sample collected by the observer | **Code** from [Sample Preservation Method](#samplePreservationMethods) | e.g., `FR20` |
| sample_destination | O | Destination of the collected sample after the trip (institution or lab of analysis) | Free entry | e.g., `University of Tasmania` |
:::
